Kannagi Exclusive. [Physical Defense] 9. [Magic Defense] 17. [Trigger: Immediately After Check] You may reroll the check you just performed. This effect cannot be used during combat. 1 scene [you may use this effect [SR of "Shikigami Master" you currently have] times. A haori adorned with the seal pattern left behind by a rare onmyōji who was said to have commanded a hundred spirits. It strengthens the bond between the wearer and their onmyō, allowing them to more effectively harness their power.

Glossy Cocoon [Core Material] (80G) + Hunter's Cloth (180G) + White Hitokata (Basic) (40G) ×2 + [Magic Catalyst 6] (50G) ×3 + Crafting Cost (180G)
